title: Billing Gateway
description: SaaS portfolios registered in the nexus-gateway billing API. Each project gets its own checkout token.
setup_hint: Set GATEWAY_API_TOKEN on the server and make sure the gateway is reachable, then refresh.
name: Slug
token_warning: This token is stored hashed and cannot be shown again. Put it in the SaaS app's environment.
rotate_description: The current token stops working immediately and a new one is issued. Continue?
delete_description: The project and all its tokens will be deleted. Past transactions stay in the ledger. Continue?
empty: No SaaS projects yet. Register the first one.
block_hint: Billingo invoice block ID. Empty = gateway master default.
merchants_hint: Merchants are invoicing identities synced from Nexus. Onboard a Nexus project to register it, then set which invoice block it bills under — API keys stay in the gateway and are never shown here.
merchants_empty: No merchants yet. Sync one via the credentials endpoint first.
block_load_failed: Could not load live blocks — you can still type the block ID manually.
onboard_description: Registers the merchant in the gateway (credentials are encrypted at rest) and optionally links it to a Nexus project. Pick the invoice block from the merchant's live Billingo blocks.
block_lookup_hint: Paste the Billingo key, then load that account's real invoice blocks to choose from.
email_branding_hint: Shown in the payment confirmation email the gateway sends with the invoice attached.
email_language_hint: Language of the payment confirmation email.
test_email_hint: Sends a sample branded email (no invoice attached).
payments_hint: Every checkout: status, invoice, and a manual resend for paid orders.
resend_description: Send the branded invoice email with PDF again to {{email}}? (Invoice {{invoice}}.)
